title: hey you
subtitle: a place to come back to yourself

steps.text: this is a place to get to know yourself again, one small step at a time.
here, the heavy things your inner voice says can become lighter, truer words. in your own voice.
and every new sentence you make becomes a stone in your foundation. something steady to build a life on.
a little secret behind the name: speaking to yourself as "you," the way a friend would, has been shown to make hard moments feel lighter.

items: there are no right answers here.
no streaks, ever. come back whenever you like.
this isn't therapy. it's a place to practice.

steps.prompt: what would you like to be called?

steps.text: whenever you're ready, let's lay your first stone.

grounding.idea: talking to yourself as "you" or by name reduces distress under stress
grounding.source: Kross et al., 2014, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology

grounding.idea: putting experiences into words can change how intense they feel
